description: Locally normalized geometric descriptors of 3–256 planar points: distances, nearest-neighbour isolation, centroid spread, PCA collinearity and histogram. The principal-axis mirror residual is null for isotropic noncoincident covariance, whose axes are undetermined. Rounded fingerprints are descriptive, not proofs of equivalence or method benefit.
name: tour_profile
title: Geometric profile of a point set
